explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/731: EGRS75 note that for almost all n, m = exp((log n)^{1/2+o(1)}). The docstring cites EGRS75 (8) for the explicit form 'for every ε > 0, outside a density-0 set, exp((log n)^{1/2−ε}) < m < exp((log n)^{1/2+ε})'. The statement asserts exactly that, as density 1 for each ε. Faithful.
